story.paragraph1: My journey started with frontend development, where I built a strong foundation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and modern UI development.
story.paragraph2: Today, I work toward becoming a stronger full-stack developer by building complete applications with the MERN stack and continuously improving my engineering practices.
